parameters.steps: GRN inference (GRNBoost2) -> Motif enrichment (cisTarget) -> Regulon activity (AUCell) -> Visualization

detailed_description:
pySCENIC基因调控网络推断。TF调控子/aUCell活性评分

分析步骤:
  - GRN inference (GRNBoost2): Infer from expression matrix
  - Motif enrichment (cisTarget): Identify direct regulation
  - Regulon activity (AUCell): Per-cell regulon scores
  - Visualization: Regulon heatmap + network

触发提示: "推断我的scRNA-seq数据的基因调控网络"
when_to_use: 当你需要 基因调控网络 (pySCENIC) 时触发

proven_params.params: n_HVG=2000, n_top_targets=50, GRNBoost2+cisTarget+full(失败), GRNBoost2-only(成功)
